learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge to draw and interpret corrosion formation diagrams.
Skill to solve corrosion rate problems.
Having knowledge about preventive measures and protection methods against corrosion.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the course and explanation of its content
Corrosion, environments causing corrosion, classification of corrosion, economic importance of corrosion
Electrochemistry, electrochemical corrosion of metals, electrochemical cell, electrode potential, electrochemical effects of corrosion, chemical potential, reference electrodes
Thermodynamic reasons for potential difference formation, effect of heat treatment, concentration cells
Potential-pH Diagrams (Pourbaix Diagrams), corrosion rate measurement, polarization
Polarization, Evans Diagrams E-T, corrosion in acid solutions
Corrosion in neutral solutions, passivation, types of corrosion, short quiz
Crevice Corrosion, Intergranular Corrosion, Exfoliation Corrosion
Dealloying, Stress Corrosion Cracking, Hydrogen Damage, Corrosion Fatigue
Erosion Corrosion, Cavitation Corrosion, Fretting Corrosion, Corrosion in various environments
Corrosion Protection, Anodic Inhibitors, Cathodic Inhibitors, Mixed (Dual-Action) Inhibitors, Cathodic Protection
bibliography: Mühendisler için Korozyon, Prof.Dr.Hayri YALÇIN, Doç.Dr.Timur KOÇ, Ankara,1998
Principles and Prevention of Corrosion, Denny A.Jones, USA, 1996.
